text:
Which statements describe the Periodic Table?
1
The elements are arranged in order of their nucleon number.
2
The elements are arranged in order of their proton number.
3
It is used to predict the properties of elements.
A
1 and 3
B
1 only
C
2 and 3
D
2 only
subject: Chemistry
